keyword: how much do the artemis astronauts get paid

verifications.claim: Artemis II astronauts earn fixed federal salaries.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "government salary that tops out around $152,000" (R1); "paid according to the “general services” pay scale" (R2); "NASA salaries follow a standardized pay scale" (R3); "standardized federal pay structure" (R5); "standard federal pay scale" (R6); "standardized federal pay scale that caps annual salaries at roughly $152,258" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm fixed federal/government salaries for Artemis II astronauts.

verifications.claim: Artemis II astronauts' salaries typically range from roughly $100,000 to over $150,000 annually.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "salaries generally ranging from approximately $90,000 to $150,000 annually" (R5); "annual salaries ranging from around $90,000 to $122,000 on average... $89,693 to $122,336 per year" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources provide similar but broader or slightly lower ranges ($90k-$150k or $90k-$122k), making the claim's 'roughly $100k to over $150k' supported but less precise.

verifications.claim: NASA crew salaries for Artemis II are capped around $152,258 to $161,000.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "around $152,258 per year" (R2); "annual salary for astronauts in 2024 was approximately US$152,258" (R3); "caps annual salaries at roughly $152,258" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently cite ~$152,258 as the cap for NASA crew; no mention of $161,000, directly contradicting the upper range.

verifications.claim: Artemis II astronauts do not receive hazard pay.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "no ... hazard pay" (R1); "don't receive performance bonuses, overtime, or hazard pay" (R4); "do not receive ... hazard pay" (R5); "lack of hazard pay" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements across sources confirm no hazard pay for Artemis II astronauts.

verifications.claim: Artemis II astronauts do not receive overtime.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "no overtime" (R1); "will not be getting any overtime pay" (R2); "do not get extra pay for overtime" (R3); "no ... overtime" (R4); "do not receive overtime compensation" (R5); "don't receive overtime" (R6); "no additional financial compensation" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple direct confirmations of no overtime pay.

verifications.claim: Artemis II astronauts do not receive bonuses for flying to the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "No performance bonus" (R1); "no monetary bonuses" (R4); "no ... any additional remuneration for time spent in space" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state no performance or mission-specific bonuses for NASA astronauts; Canadian structure noted separately but no bonus for this mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II astronauts receive only a small daily stipend for incidentals while on duty.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "small daily stipend—about $5—for incidentals" (R1, R8); "small daily stipend ... little more than $5" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Direct quotes confirm small ~$5 daily stipend for incidentals.

verifications.claim: NASA astronauts are paid based on the GS-13/14 federal government pay scale.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "GS-13 employees... “general services” pay scale" (R2); "GS-13 to GS-14 levels" (R5); "General Services pay scale" (R6); "General Schedule (GS) system, specifically targeting GS-13 or GS-14 levels" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Precise matches to GS-13/14 pay scale.

verifications.claim: NASA astronauts are paid regardless of the mission's risk or distance.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "salary remains the same whether astronauts are on Earth or in space ... no extra pay for ... going on missions" (R3); "salaries are not influenced by the magnitude of the mission" (R5); "does not fluctuate based on the specific mission or the distance traveled from Earth" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for pay independent of risk, mission, or distance.

verifications.claim: Jeremy Hansen is a Canadian Space Agency astronaut.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen" (R1); "one Canadian Space Agency astronaut" (R2); "Canadian Jeremy Hansen" (R3); "Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen" (R4, R6); "Jeremy Hansen" from CSA (R5, R7)
verifications.reasoning: All sources identify Hansen as Canadian Space Agency astronaut.

verifications.claim: Jeremy Hansen's salaries range from $97,100 to $189,600 CAD depending on experience and mission completion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "salary scale ... ranges from $97,100 to $189,600. Senior level ... for astronauts who have completed a space mission" (R2); "$97,100 to $189,600. The higher end ... for astronauts who have successfully completed a space mission" (R3); "$97,000 to nearly $190,000, with elevated salaries ... possessing mission experience" (R5); "$97,100 to $189,600, with the highest tier ... completed a space mission" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Exact range and dependence on experience/mission completion match; CAD implied by CSA context.

verifications.claim: Astronauts are paid the same whether they are working in an office on Earth or orbiting the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "salary remains the same whether astronauts are on Earth or in space" (R3); "pay remains identical to that of a senior federal employee working on the ground" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Direct equivalence stated between Earth/office and space/moon pay.

verifications.claim: Travel, lodging, and meals are covered for Artemis II crew.
